objective: Produce a signed installable node image with installer, admitted boot, update/rollback/recall, break-glass, support, and recovery ownership; HYPERVISOROS_APPLIANCE_INSTALL_UPDATE_RECOVERY_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: Schemas or attestation records are presented as an installable, recoverable node-root appliance.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

required_work: Activate only after named demand, hardware, installer, support, update, and recovery ownership exist.
positive_proof: Install, update, rollback, recover, and remove one supported node.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Tamper, failed update, rollback, node loss, and recovery faults converge safely.

external_gates.condition: Named design-partner demand, supported hardware, and installer/update/recovery/support ownership are accepted.

rollback_or_stop_rule: Remain inactive until the external gate is met.
